description: Full extracted text of one filing, one section at a time, identified by a doc_key from a search result, profile or event row. Returns headline, date, symbol, page, whether more sections exist and, for a long section, whether more text follows. Suited to reading a whole announcement rather than a snippet. Free.

offset.description: Character offset within the section's text for long sections (default 0). The response's nextOffset pages the rest.

name: filing_text
title: Filing text
